title: Camera firmware versions MV 6.3.2 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new stable camera firmware is now available on Tue, 20 May 2025

Bug fixes: Fixed Max Retention settings not applying correctly on MV84X
General: Performance and reliability improvements for video metadata services
Notice: When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 devices will run MV4.15
